summary: Your changes take effect within seconds, and the app is clearer to read.

new.title: Requests start within seconds
new.text: When you commit a change, press Run now or ask for an analysis, it now starts within seconds instead of waiting up to five minutes.

new.title: Identity report views explain their assumptions
new.text: Each Identity report view now lists where its facts come from and who it leaves out, so you know what a result means.

new.title: Clearer Audit, Tamper and Tag changes
new.text: The Audit page says in plain words what each request did. Tamper and Tag changes show the tag name instead of where it is stored.

new.title: A tidier Tagging Rules page
new.text: New rule and Test run are the main actions, with the rest in one More menu. Rules imported from v1 carry a 'from v1' badge.

new.title: Smaller wording improvements
new.text: Settings describes the alert mail choices in words, Get started folds the v1 import steps away, and the app spells 'Analyze' one way everywhere.
